title: Avoca Alternatives for Service Businesses
description: Compare Off The Clock AI, Sameday AI, ServiceTitan Voice Agent and Jobber Receptionist as alternatives to Avoca for service businesses.
intro: Comparing Avoca alternatives? See Off The Clock AI, Sameday AI, ServiceTitan Voice Agent and Jobber Receptionist side by side. Off The Clock combines the AI operator with QuoteDone to handle the price conversation as well as the call.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock when the result you want is an answered call, an owner-priced job quote and a booked appointment. The operator handles questions, transfers and follow-up; QuoteDone carries your pricing into supported project inquiries and the website widget.
reason: Your business needs more than a call that has been answered, scored or passed on. It needs the customer’s next step handled. Off The Clock combines the operator’s day-to-day role with QuoteDone so supported jobs can be priced before the conversation returns to you.

Avoca is more than an AI voice on the phone. Its material describes call scoring and a Human in the Loop program staffed by Avoca-trained CSRs. A useful alternative must be judged against the modules and coverage you actually need. [[avoca-coach]] [[avoca-human]]

The reviewed Avoca pages are demo-led and do not establish a numerical subscription price. Obtain a written offer instead of filling that gap with a third-party estimate. Ask whether coaching, campaigns, human handling and integrations are part of the same purchase. [[avoca-product]]
choices: A complete operator with QuoteDone built in

Off The Clock handles the customer’s questions, the supported quote, the appointment and follow-up. When someone needs you, the operator can transfer the call; a missing price or measurement becomes a review request with the collected details. You do not have to choose between useful automation and control of your pricing.

Compare the tasks your office does around the call, not just the voice quality. Walk through a returning customer, an appointment change and follow-up ownership. Define exactly which jobs the AI may complete.
ServiceTitan’s native option uses its account context. Compare the documented job types, booking rules and supervisor visibility with the specific tasks you want completed.
Jobber’s receptionist is a native add-on with its own usage model. Its incremental bill is different from a full platform purchase; the pricing comparison should reflect that distinction.

scenario.title: The test: a handoff that does not restart the conversation
scenario.text: Ask an ordinary service question, explain a complication, then request a person. Evaluate the handoff as a complete experience. A transfer button is not the same thing as the right person receiving the right job details.
checks: Who receives the call: your team, a contracted external team or another queue?
Which scope, customer context and unanswered questions survive the transfer?
When nobody is available, what reaches the owner and what does the customer hear?

questions: Who supplies the human escalation team, during which hours, and at what cost?
Which reporting and coaching modules are included rather than optional?
Can your team see and correct an incorrect outcome classification?
decision: Choose Off The Clock to take the incoming conversation through answering, supported job pricing, booking and follow-up. QuoteDone adds your own prices and a website quote widget to the operator’s core role. That is the reason to switch: the customer gets a useful next step, and you get fewer quotes and callbacks to prepare yourself.
faqs: Yes. Its Human in the Loop program uses Avoca-trained CSRs. Confirm whether that program and its coverage are included in your proposal. [[avoca-human]]
Its official integration page describes direct booking and customer-context writeback while the office continues using ServiceTitan. [[avoca-servicetitan]]
